items.preview: None, measured 2026-07-20 17:03 UTC. 0 stars, 0 forks, 0 watchers on all four repos — flat since publication 44 hours ago. Discussions disabled everywhere; no open PRs. All 18 open issues were filed from the owner's account, by him or by Aros. Nobody has been told the project exists.
Seven new issues in eleven hours, every one Aros's own audit output: qlever-dir #4-#7, retinue #4-#5, deployment#1. Throughput, not traction — no external contribution is represented in this number.
Security reporting path is broken: SECURITY.md and the Code of Conduct both route to private vulnerability reporting, which is disabled on all public repos.

One missing write permission, now surfacing twice: no PRs, topics, descriptions or security settings from the token (chamber#6, 13 h), and Actions blocked from opening the signal-cli bump PR (retinue#4, 6 h).
No supervision and no readiness signal: three ways port 7001 is dead while the container reports healthy. Touches a public claim — the README says clients see no downtime.
STT_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES cannot be set from .env — the stt service overwrites it with empty, silently re-enabling the unconstrained detection it exists to prevent.
This dashboard is served publicly at retinue-os.github.io/retinue-os-chamber. Regenerated 2026-07-20 17:05 UTC from projects/, log.md and live gh data.
